- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to increase engagement on LinkedIn include:

  5. Utilize LinkedIn's publishing features.

  7. Participate in LinkedIn Groups.
  8. Time your posts strategically.
  9. Use hashtags strategically.
  10. Monitor and respond to comments.
  11. Run LinkedIn Ads.
  12. Share user-generated content.
  13. Utilize LinkedIn's video feature.
  14. Collaborate with influencers.
  15. Track and measure your performance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should aim to post at least once a week on LinkedIn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Minimum daily budget for LinkedIn Ads is recommended to be $10-$50.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average CPC on LinkedIn varies from $2 to $10 or more.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average CPM on LinkedIn typically falls between $10 to $50.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example budget scenarios for LinkedIn Ads include:
  - Small-scale awareness campaign: $500-$1,000 per month.
  - Mid-scale lead generation campaign: $2,000-$5,000 per month.
  - Large-scale conversion campaign: $10,000-$20,000 per month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for optimizing LinkedIn Ads budget include starting small and scaling up, targeting high-quality audiences, monitoring and optimizing ad performance, and using LinkedIn's automation features.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to set up a LinkedIn Ads campaign include:
  1. Create a LinkedIn Ads account.
  2. Choose your ad objective.
  3. Define your target audience.
  4. Set your budget and bidding.
  5. Create your ad content.
  6. Launch and monitor your campaign.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Custom audiences can be set up by creating a new audience in the LinkedIn Ads platform and uploading a list
